meta.title: Consumer Protection Act, 2002, S.O. 2002, c. 30, Sched. A

section.title: Disclosure of information (internet agreements)
section.paragraph: Before a consumer enters into an internet agreement, the supplier shall disclose the prescribed information to the consumer. 2002, c. 30, Sched. A, s. 38 (1).
The supplier shall provide the consumer with an express opportunity to accept or decline the agreement and to correct errors immediately before entering into it. 2002, c. 30, Sched. A, s. 38 (2).

In addition to the requirements set out in section 5, disclosure under this section shall be accessible and shall be available in a manner that ensures that,
the consumer has accessed the information; and
the consumer is able to retain and print the information. 2002, c. 30, Sched. A, s. 38 (3).

section.title: Copy of internet agreement
section.paragraph: A supplier shall deliver to a consumer who enters into an internet agreement a copy of the agreement in writing within the prescribed period after the consumer enters into the agreement. 2002, c. 30, Sched. A, s. 39 (1).
The copy of the internet agreement shall include such information as may be prescribed. 2002, c. 30, Sched. A, s. 39 (2).

section.title: Cancellation of internet agreement
section.paragraph:
A consumer may cancel an internet agreement at any time from the date the agreement is entered into until seven days after the consumer receives a copy of the agreement if,
the supplier did not disclose to the consumer the information required under subsection 38 (1); or
the supplier did not provide to the consumer an express opportunity to accept or decline the agreement or to correct errors immediately before entering into it. 2002, c. 30, Sched. A, s. 40 (1).
A consumer may cancel an internet agreement within 30 days after the date the agreement is entered into, if the supplier does not comply with a requirement under section 39. 2004, c. 19, s. 7 (7).
